name: NeoGenomics, Inc.
summary: NeoGenomics, Inc. operates a network of cancer-focused testing laboratories in the United States and the United Kingdom. The company offers testing services to hospitals, academic centers, pathologists, oncologists, clinicians, pharmaceutical companies, and clinical laboratories.
